parameters.name: DestinationId
parameters.description: The data destination ID. You can call the [ListDestination](~~433025~~) operation to query the list of data destinations and obtain the **DestinationId**.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: IsFailover
parameters.description:
Specifies whether this data destination configuration is used to forward error data, which is data that failed to be forwarded to other cloud services and failed after retries.

- **true**: The data destination is used to forward error data.
- **false**: The data destination is not used to forward error data. It is used for normal forwarding operations.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: ParserId
parameters.description: The parser ID. You can call the [ListParsers](~~429046~~) operation to query the list of parsers and obtain the **ParserId**.
